description: Chinese Academy of Sciences researchers assemble environmental, infrastructure and production indicators for 1,241 townships and socioeconomic indicators for 111 counties in Guangxi. Raster parameters are aggregated against administrative boundaries, while county statistics come from the Guangxi Statistical Yearbook. The ScienceDB repository applies CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. Its inspected description does not specify the full observation period or delivered file formats. The indicators can define local conditions and demand assumptions in regional infrastructure simulations. Aggregated values do not preserve all variation within a township, and the provider’s statement about retained precision should not be read as a guarantee against aggregation error. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Social-economic and environmental dataset at township and county scales in Guangxi Zhuang Auto nomous Region
